name: claude-code-kit
description: Guard hooks, tool plugins with their skills inside, research subagents, an inbox monitor and an MCP template for Claude Code.

plugins.name: request-guard
plugins.description: Every request to a public website counted and spaced (PreToolUse on Bash, PowerShell, WebFetch and browser navigation; back-off on 403/429/503), plus a paced fetcher and the fetch-paced skill.

plugins.name: session-guard
plugins.description: Keeps a session-notes file fresh: a Stop hook blocks a tool-using turn once while the notes are stale, untouched or missing; PreCompact records compactions. Includes the session-notes skill.

plugins.name: action-guard
plugins.description: Refuses or asks about actions against one web application: writes, protected paths, browser form input and JavaScript on its pages, and listed MCP tools. Policy in a JSON file.
